$comment: Project-defined draft (disclosure_export_schema_version 0.1.0) of the SAFE-Starter-Kit export of one approved disclosure package version. This is NOT an official SAFE schema: SAFE v1.0 adopts no disclosure export format. Fields and enums are provisional until the F0 decision log is signed off.
title: SAFE-Starter-Kit disclosure package export (draft 0.1.0)
description: One disclosure package version as approved, served by GET /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/disclosures/{version_id}/export and written by 'safe-kit case disclosure export'. Only a version with an approval can be exported. A version that a later version of its package replaced is exported with status 'superseded' and is history only. The document holds the derivatives of the version, never originals; the TLP audience of each item; the withheld items as placeholders with no detail; the manifest line ranges of the items the caller may see; the digest; and the approval reference. It never holds a file name, a case title, a redaction reason, the checksum of an original, or an internal redaction identifier. It has no export time, so an unchanged version exports the same document. Timestamps are UTC or carry an offset (RFC 3339).

disclosure_export_schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Changes to the fields or enums change it.

case_id.description: The case the package belongs to.

package_id.description: The package that groups the versions.

status.description: 'approved': the latest version of the package, with its approval. 'superseded': an approved version that a later version replaced. Its approval covers this version only; it is history and must not be sent as current.

latest_version.description: Number of the latest version of the package. It equals version when status is 'approved'.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical content of the version, as approved.

items.description: One entry per derivative of the version, ordered by evidence ID. An item the caller may not see is only {"withheld": true}.

withheld_count.description: Number of entries of items that are withheld. Equal to the count of {"withheld": true} entries.

items.description: The removed line ranges of each visible item. No removed text, no redaction reason.

approved_by.description: ID of the approver. Never the preparer.

digest.description: The digest the approver confirmed. It equals the digest of the version.

evidence_id.description: ID of the derivative item. Never an original.

sha256_plaintext.description: Checksum of the derivative item. Never the checksum of its original.

tlp_label.description: TLP label of the derivative item.
